governed-logic: Governed Logic is the upstream, bidirectional reasoning architecture in which truth governs logic, logic governs reasoning, and reasoning remains answerable to its ultimate ground.
governed-intelligence: Governed Intelligence is the artificial-intelligence instantiation of Governed Logic.
sufficient-grounding: Sufficiency asks whether a proposed ground can bear the explanatory, ontological, rational, semantic, or normative load placed upon it.
ultimate-grounding: An ultimate ground is not grounded by something more fundamental in the same relevant respect.
governing-referent: A referent is that to which a representation refers.
alpha-and-omega-reasoning: Alpha and Omega reasoning is the bidirectional structure within Governed Logic.
